thesis: The site is a year in a Collin County yard told through the soil: a wavy clay line runs under every section, cracking in summer and closing in winter, with a frost-blue edge in the freeze band.

signature.name: soil-line
signature.summary: Horizontal SVG soil wave divider that cracks wider in summer sections and closes in fall/winter; frost-blue top edge in the freeze band. Reused in hero bottom edge, season dividers, proof rules and footer. Hook: data-sw-signature='soil-line'.

motion.intro: H1 line-mask reveal beside frosty lawn photo; soil line draws in at bottom. ≤ 1.2 s.
stories: Soil line cracks and closes across four season bands, pinned ≥ 640px
